tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod bzhugs so// swasti pradz+nya bh+yaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod ces bya ba bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma la/ /skyabs su mchi'o bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can don slad du/ /bdag ni zung 'jug dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang thob phyir gsang chen zab mo'i bcud/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len bgyid/ /rang bzhin rnam dag stong nyid 'od gsal ngang / /rab 'jigs bsrung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i gzhi/ /zhing mchog dag pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus/ /seng khri pad nyi bdud kyi gdan steng du/ /skyabs gsum ngo bo dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon he ru ka /bstan bsrung gtso bo mahā kā la dngos/ /bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /mtshan mo char sprin rol pa'i sku mchog la/ /nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od rab tu 'bar/ /dran pa'i mod la snying la bde ster zhing / /bdud dang srin po'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mi'u thung gel ba'i gzugs/ /gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍe'i phyag mtshan can/ /dar nag lhab lhun stag sham rus rgyan 'chang / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /bdag la brtse ba'i thugs rjes gzigs pa yis/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum dngos yig 'brus mtshan/ /de nyid thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ /sprin ltar gtibs nas rje btsun nyid la bstims/

/de ltar skyabs mchog kun 'dus bla ma rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs/ /mgon po khyod la bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /byang chub bar gyi re ltos snying nas zhu/ /lus srog longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho cher/ /sprul nas mgon khyod mnyes phyir 'bul lags na/ /bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thogs med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung dang / /khyad par dam pa rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid/ /tha mal tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rab 'byams la/ /skal dman log pa bltas pa thol lo bshags/ /gang gi drin las lhan skyes bde ba che/ /skad cig nyid la shar ba'i dga' ston gyi/ /bdag gi snying gis pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i/ /bka' drin 'khor med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun khyab gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /dga' chen yan lag bdun ldan he ru ka /gsang chen legs pa'i lam ston drin can rje/ /blo gros zla med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mthong bas tha mal rtog pa 'gag /gang gsung thos pa'i snying la bde chen ster/ /gang thugs dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman ci byung yang / /mgon khyod ma gtogs skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i dbyings nas 'bral med skyongs/ /cir snang bla ma'i snod bcud skur shes shing / /sgra rnams grag stong rdo rje'i gsung du shar/ /sems nyid chos sku bde chen khyod thugs dang / /nam yang 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog /gnas skabs su yang tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal dang longs spyod dbang phyug 'khor 'bangs sogs/ /phun tshogs yar ngo'i zla dbang ltar rgyas nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma rtag tu mchod par shog

/nam zhig rje btsun rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod/ /gang du bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams der/ /'khor du skyes nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / /gsang chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi 'tsho bar shog /de ltar gsol bas rje btsun bla ma de/ /dges shing 'dzum pas 'od stong phung por zhu/ /bdag la brtser dgongs spyi bo'i gtsug nas thim/ /rang sems ngang du dbyer med ro gcig 'dres/ /gsal dwangs snang ba ma 'gags bla ma'i sku/ /rang bzhin stong nyid dag pa bla ma'i gsung / /zung 'jug brjod bral blo gsal bla ma'i thugs/ /gnas lugs rje btsun bla ma'i rang zhal blta/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yis/ /bla ma mnyes par byed pa shog /khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs der/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel ba mdzad du gsol/ /bdag sogs rnams kyi chos dang mthun pa'i don/ /ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /nad gdon bgegs rnams bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /nye bar zhi ba byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing / /bsgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga rdo rje nag po chen po'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa 'di ni rje nyid kyi bka' drin thugs kyi pad+mor sims pas zhabs rdul gtsug rgyan dam par bzung nas mnyes pa mtha' dag sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po zhal ngo rnams kyi thugs dam du/

bka' 'bangs ban sde blo gsal rgya mtshos gus pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bgyis so// //ྀatsha/ maṅgalaṃ bha wan+tu/ bsam don 'grub par gyur gcig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
